answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the plume of the next round.
